install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own compose file pulls minio from cgr.dev (Chainguard), blocked. Beyond that, the main langfuse/langfuse-worker images pull from docker.langfuse.com, the project's own vendor registry - also blocked (403), only discovered once cgr.dev was fixed. Both are the same project's own images also published to Docker Hub (langfuse/langfuse:4, langfuse/langfuse-worker:4, exact same major version tag) - substituted those directly. minio/minio itself is no longer published to Docker Hub at all (MinIO moved off Docker Hub entirely) - used bitnamilegacy/minio instead (a maintained, widely-used minio build, also already used elsewhere in this project's own compose variants), with MINIO_DEFAULT_BUCKETS replacing the original entrypoint's manual mkdir-then-serve wrapper, and a curl-based healthcheck replacing `mc ready local` (bitnami's image doesn't bundle the mc CLI).
